name: Hand-Drawn Brand Motion Bumper
description: A short hand-drawn picture-book brand bumper (~6s, 4:3 or 1:1) in the naive-cartoon / felt-tip register: a chunky bubble wordmark pops in, a single letter hand-corrects in (the signature), an organic blob marker-wipe floods the canvas and shrinks back into a product-shaped window, and a single sustained drawn mascot waves out of that window while a two-line slogan types word-by-word with ONE highlighted keyword. Built in HyperFrames (single composition, one paused GSAP timeline); the load-bearing trick is the 'boil' layer — every drawn shape gets a 1-2px frame-by-frame vertex jitter via animation: boil .166s steps(1) infinite, selling the cel-animation feel. Color, fonts, and the wipe physics are SITE-GROUNDED: pull the brand's real palette + self-hosted webfonts and override the reference accent to the brand's own (pick the highlight from across the color wheel so it never clashes). The ONE mascot is the only paid asset — gpt-5.4-image-2 transparent PNG locked to the picture-book line aesthetic; an optional seedance-2.0 t2v pass renders a fully-animated alternate cut. Elastic pop-ins (scale 0 -> 1.08 -> 1) on every entrance, never linear fades.
referenceNotes: Site-ground the brand: pull its real palette + self-hosted webfonts. ONE mascot reference is generated (gpt-5.4-image-2 transparent PNG); no user-supplied photo refs required.
